subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate full-width text plus voice-note delivery, and where should that policy live?
rationale: The source-level behavior is clear, but the fix would create a public config/channel contract and overlaps with active captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions, so automation should not choose the contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define bundled/captioned versus separate behavior, document it, and require Telegram tests plus live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery standard
options.body: Document tagged/manual splitting and overflow fallback instead of adding another config surface.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 direction before deciding whether separate delivery should be first-class.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define bundled/captioned versus separate behavior, document it, and require Telegram tests plus live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available history across core TTS policy, Telegram caption delivery, and the channel/plugin contract boundary this decision would touch.
